name: Spinach, Egg, and Feta Breakfast Pockets

ingredients.name: puff pastry, homemade or defrosted if store bought
egg beaten lightly with 1 teaspoon water, for egg wash

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 400°F. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Rinse spinach with water; do not dry. In a wide, shallow skillet, wilt spinach over medium heat. Let cool then wring dry.
In a medium bowl, combine spinach, scallions, feta, and hard boiled egg. Season with salt and pepper (you may not need any salt depending on how salty your feta is).

Cut puff pastry into eight 4 1/2-inch circles. Top 4 circles with spinach filling. Cover each circle with another piece of dough and use a fork to crimp and seal the sides. Brush each pastry with egg wash. Bake until pastry is puffed and golden, about 30 minutes. Serve warm.

schema_metadata.keywords: breakfast pastries, feta, puff pastry, spinach, wake and bake

description: These golden puff pastry pockets are filled with spinach, feta, scallions, and hard boiled eggs. They make a great savory to-go breakfast or a new spin on a classic omelet flavor.
author: Carrie Vasios Mullins
